## opencode {VERSION}

{Prerelease/Stable} release from `{branch}` branch. Context folding now survives multi-agent and parallel sessions, Anthropic structured outputs no longer opt into a rejected beta header, and the unit-test pipeline runs in parallel shards with a fixed Turbo cache.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Keep folding provenance isolated per session**: A subagent or parallel session with a different model or tool set no longer clears the parent's folding evidence. The tool-source ledger now keeps its signature and generation per session, so duplicate `read`/`grep`/`glob` outputs remain eligible for folding. Generations are not reused across A-B-A switches. Memory stays bounded by 1024 sessions with LRU eviction and the existing global 4096-identity limit; evicted evidence fails closed. Saved messages are unchanged (#765, #766).
- **Use GA Anthropic structured outputs without an automatic beta**: A version-pinned patch to `@ai-sdk/anthropic@3.0.125` removes the automatic `structured-outputs-2025-11-13` header value that Bedrock-backed Anthropic requests rejected with HTTP 400. Structured JSON output still uses the GA `output_config.format` field. Strict tools, the JSON-tool fallback, explicitly requested beta values, and unrelated automatic betas are preserved (#767, #769).

---

### ⚙️ CI / Engineering

- **Parallelize unit tests and fix CI caching**: The single required unit-test job ran everything serially and took about 32 minutes per pass. The workflow now splits into a workspace job (35 of 36 test tasks, Go, VS Code, generated client/SDK checks), four sharded opencode jobs sized from recorded test timings, and a dedicated HttpAPI job, aggregated by the unchanged `Unit Tests (linux)` required check. The Turbo cache now saves `.turbo/cache` instead of a path Turbo 2 never reads, ripgrep installation is cached via a composite action, and verified PR evidence can be reused on `main` for an identical tree (the merge commit's PR-head run is located, its proof artifact verified, and the tree fingerprint compared; cache key moved to v5). Required check names are unchanged (#762, #763).
- **Remove dead GitHub workflow leftovers**: Deleted the fully commented-out `.github/publish-python-sdk.yml` and the unused `.github/actions/setup-git-committer`, which referenced upstream secrets this fork does not have. Deletion only; all five real workflows and referenced composite actions are unchanged (#760, #761).

### 🔍 Verification

The cross-session folding regression fails on the old ledger and passes after the fix. Removing the LRU refresh makes its regression test fail. The Anthropic wire suite had 16 failures against the unpatched SDK and passes all 32 tests after the patch. Native Nix dependency hashes were measured on all four supported platforms in [run 38227786477](https://github.com/LeXwDeX/OpenCode-GraphAgent/actions/runs/38227786477), rather than inferred from archive hashes or evaluation. After updating the hashes, the normal CLI and desktop packages built successfully on x86_64-linux, aarch64-linux, aarch64-darwin, and x86_64-darwin in [run 38229126583](https://github.com/LeXwDeX/OpenCode-GraphAgent/actions/runs/38229126583). All checks passed on each runtime PR's final head.

Anthropic tests use synthetic fake-fetch requests; no live AWS/Anthropic account acceptance is claimed. The patch does not add structured-output support to unsupported models or endpoints, including the Bedrock Mantle Anthropic Messages endpoint. Thinking prefix/signature failures remain a separate open investigation in #768 and are not fixed by this release.
